description: Road Deaths in Australia 1925-2008 is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Road Safety Data Hub and Analytics. This information sheet contains a historical overview of road death statistics in Australia from 1925, when road deaths were first recorded, to 2008. Coverage is Australia, 1925 to 2008; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-05-30. Files and pages listed: PDF (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
